name: Benares Hotels Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1971, Benares Hotels Limited (BHL) operates its hotels, viz. Taj Ganges and Taj Nadesar Palace in Varanasi, and Ginger, Gondia in Maharashtra. [1]
keyPoints:
Holding Company[1]
The Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) is the ultimate Holding Company of BHL.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 31.8% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 28.7%
